An electron in an atom absorbs a photon and transitions from energy level to energy level .

Consider the following three statements:

I. The energy of the photon must be equal to or greater than the energy difference between the two energy levels.

II.

III. After the transition the atom becomes excited.

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
